text: A court can erase a child's record. It cannot give back the years.
provenance: But a cleared record is not a returned childhood.

text: Pennsylvania's Supreme Court reached back into that courtroom and unmade it, throwing out thousands of adjudications and clearing the records of as many as several thousand children.
provenance: It reached back into Ciavarella's courtroom and unmade it — throwing out thousands of adjudications, clearing the records of as many as several thousand children.

text: Behind each of those cases was a year, or two, or three that the county had already spent. Nights in a cell that no order could give back.
provenance: Behind each of those cases was a year, or two, or three, that the county had already spent — nights in a cell that no order could give back.
The paperwork could be erased. The time could not.

text: The judges are named and gone. One spent years in prison. The other was quietly granted an early release, and walked back out while the children he sentenced were still carrying theirs.
provenance: The judges are named and gone. One spent years in prison. The other, quietly, was granted an early release and walked back out into the world while the children he sentenced were still carrying theirs.

text: The men could be punished. The years still do not come back. That is what a cleared record cannot reach.
provenance: Because that is the last, hardest truth of this story: the men could be punished, and still the years don't come back.
